entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Windows] TapGestureRecognizer does NOT work on a ContentView without Background #32279
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Modify the GlobalWindowInsetListener so that it gets applied directly to the AppBarLayout vs how we are currently searching for the AppBarLayout #32277
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [NET10] SafeAreaEdges cannot be set for Shell and the flyout menu collides with display notch and status bar in landscape mode #32275
    .NET 10 SR1
  • TapGestureRecognizer in CollectionView2 does not work after ItemsSource is refreshed #32273
    .NET 10 SR1
  • Log a Warning when Xaml has to set 'required' property #32272
    .NET 10 SR1
  • ScrollView with RTL FlowDirection and Horizontal Orientation scrolls in the wrong direction on iOS #32271
    .NET 10 SR1
  • System.ObjectDisposedException when closing app during asynchronous UI updates on Windows and macOS #32269
    Backlog
  • Nullable support is not working properly on Windows TimePicker and macOS DatePicker and TImePicker #32266
    .NET 10 SR1
  • Review the feature matrix test area for scroll view as it relates to regression 32221 #32260
    Backlog
  • .net MAUI 9 Shell.PresentationMode = NotAnimated does not work on Android 15 #32258
  • CollectionView content clipped when keyboard is open on Android #32257
  • Review the feature matrix test area for collection view as it relates to regression 32212 and 32225 #32256
    Backlog

Closed

  • [Android] Bottom SafeArea not working in nested Grid #32259
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • Cannot compile MAUI project - NuGet references to Microsoft packages fail #32209
  • Migrate changes to Developer Balance template to our sample content templates #32111
    Backlog
  • [Android] Picker remains focused when clicking Cancel from the AlertDialog #32138
  • [testing] Error in Testing related to ignoring sample tests for GA #32151
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • set EnableMauiXamlDiagnostics to true in templates, and for all debug builds #32047
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [XSG] input needs to be trimmed #32034
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • [.NET10][XAML inflator] `x:Reference` does not appear to work #31995

Created

  • Extract markdown documentation changes from PR #32064 and merge enhancements from PR #32270 #32280
  • [Android] Refactor WindowInsetListener to per-CoordinatorLayout registry with optimized lookups #32278
  • [Android] Fix bottom safe area not applying to nested layouts #32276
  • [XSG] report a warning on usage of required #32274
    .NET 10 SR1
  • [iOS] Fix ScrollView does not resize when children are removed from StackLayout at runtime #32267
    platform/ios, area-controls-scrollview, partner/syncfusion
  • [XSG] forward staticresource exc to XHR #32263
    .NET 10 SR1
  • Small fixes nceng #32262

    p/0, .NET 10.0 GA

    .NET 10 SR1
